<DESCRIPTION>EXHIBIT 31.1
<TEXT>
<body bgcolor="#ffffff">
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: right" align=right><font style="COLOR: black">Exhibit 31.1</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><font style="COLOR: black">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: center" align=center><font style="COLOR: black">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: center" align=center><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO SECTION 302</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: center" align=center><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">OF THE SARBANES-OXLEY ACT OF 2002</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">I, Daniel S. Mckinney, certify that:</font></p>
		<pre style="tab-stops: .5in"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></pre>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">1.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>I have reviewed this quarterly report on Form 10-QSB of Asia Properties, Inc.</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">2.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>Based on my knowledge, this quarterly report does not contain any untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state a material fact necessary to make the statements made, in light of the circumstances under which such statements were made, not misleading with respect to the period covered by this quarterly report.</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">3.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>Based on my knowledge, the financial statements, and other financial information included in this quarterly report, fairly present in all material respects the financial condition, results of operations and cash flows of the registrant as of, and for, the periods presented in this quarterly report.</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
	<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">4.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>I am responsible for establishing and maintaining disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Exchange Act Rules 13a-14 and 15d-14) for the registrant and have:<br>
			<br>
		</font></p>
	<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">a.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>Designed such disclosure controls and procedures to ensure that material information relating to the registrant, including its consolidated subsidiaries, is made known to me by others within those entities, particularly during the period in which this quarterly report is being prepared;</font></p>
	<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">b.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>Evaluated the effectiveness of the registrant's disclosure controls and procedures as of a date within 90 days prior to the filing date of this quarterly report (the &quot;Evaluation Date&quot;); and</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">c.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>Presented in this quarterly report my conclusions about the effectiveness of the disclosure controls and procedures based on my evaluation as of the Evaluation Date.</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">5.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>I have disclosed, based on my most recent evaluation, to the registrant's auditors and the audit committee of registrant's board of directors (or persons performing the equivalent functions):</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">a.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>All significant deficiencies in the design or operation of internal controls that could adversely affect the registrant's ability to record, process, summarize and report financial data and have identified for the registrant's auditors any material weaknesses in internal controls; and</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">b.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>Any fraud, whether or not material, that involves management or other employees who have a significant role in the registrant's internal controls.</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0.5in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">6.<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>I have indicated in this quarterly report whether there were significant changes in internal controls or in other factors that could significantly affect internal controls subsequent to the date of our most recent evaluation, including any corrective actions with regard to significant deficiencies and material weaknesses.</font></p>
		<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; COLOR: black; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoBlockText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .5in"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoBlockText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .5in"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">&nbsp;</font></p>
		<p class=MsoBlockText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .5in"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">Date:<font style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </font>February 17, 2005 <font style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font style="mso-tab-count: 2">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font>By: <u><font style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font style="mso-tab-count: 2">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font style="mso-tab-count: 2">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font style="mso-tab-count: 2">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font></u></font></p>
		<p class=MsoBlockText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 3.5in; tab-stops: .5in"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 11pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt">Daniel S. Mckinney, President, Chief Executive Officer, Principal Accounting Officer and Director (Principal Executive, Financial and Accounting Officer)</font></p>
		<font style="FONT-SIZE: 12pt; COLOR: black; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA"><br style="PAGE-BREAK-BEFORE: always; mso-special-character: line-break" clear=all>
